items.title: How space weather powers auroras in the sky and threatens power grids on the ground
items.summary: An aurora is one of nature's most spectacular light shows: It looks like green or red curtains rippling across the night sky. When viewed from the ground, this colorful display might seem far away and disconnected from anything happening on Earth's surface.

items.title: 100 buses long: Scientists map one of the world's largest known coral colonies
items.summary: A huge coral colony stretching more than 1.5 kilometers (0.93 miles) along the outer reef of the Cocos (Keeling) Islands has been identified by researchers, making it one of the largest known coral colonies ever recorded.

items.title: New species of ground-dwelling bird, the largest of its kind, identified in same cave as Homo floresiensis
items.summary: In 2009, researchers working in the Liang Bua cave on Flores Island came across a leg bone. The 190,000–120,000-year-old fossil was identified as a bird bone and set aside. Like many bird bones before it, it was overlooked and left to collect dust.

items.title: Chimp sanctuary delivers an ape's food by drone amid Florida floods
items.summary: A Florida chimpanzee sanctuary had to deliver food to one of its 200 apes by drone this week because the property was swamped by heavy rain. But the animals stayed safe, and the water finally was receding significantly on Saturday, the organization said.
